X=10.5502356933..14.1002356933, Z=-2.0..-1.1 mm. Outer bounds and other face signatures agree; the change is an interface difference, not added cosmetic detail.

findings: No exact individual source for k190x90 a140x120. The catalog k220x120 a140x50 candidate has a 2.2 mm head versus 1.9 mm in assembly and bottom Z=-3.3 versus -3.7 mm. Both symmetric differences are nonempty. Excluded despite similar shaft naming.

findings: Assembly and individual STEP are identical, invalid BReps with 3 of 23 faces missing tessellation. findings: Both STEP imports are invalid and have 10090 faces with identical volume/area and face signatures at 1e-7 mm rounding; mesh vertices differ by up to 0.0062208321 mm.
